## Rendering

Docling's native threaded renderer and PDFium rasterize the same pages against a white background. Docling images are resampled to the reference dimensions for pixel comparison. The report counts size mismatches separately.

Compared **496** of **496** pages. Size mismatches: **0**. Above reporting tolerance: **31**.

| Metric | Mean | Median | Maximum | Distribution |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Normalized delta | 0.0076 | 0.0067 | 0.0592 | [Histogram](histogram_normalized_delta.png) |
| Mean absolute error | 1.4023 | 1.2597 | 11.3270 | [Histogram](histogram_mean_abs_error.png) |

## Text extraction

Docling extracts plain and fixed-width layout text through PdfEditor. PDFium uses its page text for plain mode and benchmark-reconstructed glyph positions for layout mode. pypdf, when selected, uses its own modes.

Token F1 compares unique whitespace-delimited tokens after NFC normalization. Layout position F1 also requires each token to start at the same row and column.

| Reference | Mode | Scored | Unavailable | Mean token F1 | Median token F1 | Mean position F1 | Distribution |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| PDFium | layout | 496 | 0 | 0.9367 | 0.9866 | 0.2211 | [Histogram](text-pypdfium2-layout-f1.png) |
| PDFium | plain | 496 | 0 | 0.9340 | 0.9856 | — | [Histogram](text-pypdfium2-plain-f1.png) |
